propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) only check the origin/main snapshot and ignore prerequisites, causing symbols created by depended-on tickets to be flagged as missing/unverifiable and block the plan
The documented rule that symbols created by depended-on tickets are treated as existing exists only in prose (plan_review_G1G2.md:10) but is not implemented in code

A two-layer approach (deterministic advisory Layer-1 edge verification + LLM Layer-2 coverage confirmation) should honor machine-parseable [rebar:<ticket-id>] citations without adding new blocking gates to det_floor
Layer-1 must verify both upstream encodings: depending tickets contain depends_on edges to cited prerequisites, OR cited tickets contain blocks edges pointing back to the depending ticket

Layer-2 must use the show_ticket tool to judge whether the cited ticket's plan/file_impact provides the specific functionality claimed missing, failing closed if coverage is uncertain or the citation lacks Layer-1 verification
